environment.budget: single session, xhigh reasoning effort, one attempt

independence.statement: All numeric findings below were re-derived either (a) from first principles (the p-value floor and Holm-threshold formulas) before checking them against archived data, or (b) by directly executing the FROZEN, UNMODIFIED implementation code under experiments/EXP-MONO-670aa6/implementation/ (imported as-is, never edited) to extract intermediate values the archived raw-result.json does not persist. No archived run artifact, ledger record, or the Coordinator's own correction record was taken on faith for a numeric claim; every quoted number was independently recomputed.
independent_pieces: Permutation p-value floor (1/(n+1)) and Holm-Bonferroni loosest-per-comparison threshold (alpha/m), derived from the standard formulas, not copied from CORR-20260831-d15d36's text
Direct extraction and pairwise comparison of realized (p, A, B, t_used) across all 50 matching curve_ordinals in both primary-panel families via build_primary_panel()
Independent route1-vs-route2 cross-check on 120 fresh null-subset draws on the panel's largest-N curves (field_bits=11), not present in the archived run

Independent recovery of Stage-2 null-object-arm raw per-curve p-values (not persisted in raw-result.json) by re-running the deterministic implementation, verified to reproduce the archived Holm-adjusted summaries bit-for-bit before being used further
Fisher's combined-probability test (scipy.stats.chi2) computed independently on both the archived real-arm raw p-values and the freshly-recovered null-object raw p-values

OBJ1_floor_confirmed.conclusion: No possible outcome of the declared Stage-2/Stage-3 design could ever be Holm-significant, at any true effect size.

OBJ2_family_collision_sharpened.conclusion: 100% of realized pairs share prime, B coefficient, and acceptance index; collision also propagates into controls.py's null-sampling Drawer key, not only panel_primary.py's curve construction.

OBJ3_route2_coverage_gap.supplementary_check_curves: field_bits=11 (largest N in panel, highest float-rounding stress)
OBJ3_route2_coverage_gap.conclusion: Real, previously-undisclosed validation-coverage gap in the archived run; my own supplementary check found no actual correctness failure.

OBJ4_fisher_combined_reanalysis.conclusion: No significant deviation in either family, either seed; candidate resource for a properly pre-registered successor, per agents/red-team.md #8.

proves_too_much_finding.reason_not_load_bearing: That objection's overall conclusion rests on four other, non-floor-limited independent lines of evidence (raw uncorrected min p=0.124 far from the floor, a continuous z-score reanalysis, a 254-independently-constructed-curve replication, a 3000-replicate null-object base rate), none of which depend on the vacuous Bonferroni sentence.
proves_too_much_finding.exp_mono_12ce1c_reason: Does not use a permutation-p-value + multiple-comparison-correction design anywhere in its specification or review reports (grep-confirmed).
